title: [IMPORTANT] Prerequisites and how to succeed in this course

cues.en: In this video, I will explain the background knowledge that you need before starting this course.
cues.zh: 這段說明，開始課程前需要哪些背景知識。

cues.en: The background knowledge that you don't necessarily need, but will be really helpful if you have.
cues.zh: 哪些不一定必需，但有會很有幫助。

cues.en: And I will also address some other issues like how to learn best in this course, whether you need to follow the lectures in order, and so on.
cues.zh: 也談如何有效學習、是否要依序看課等問題。

cues.en: Here's the thing.
cues.zh: 先說。

cues.en: LMS are difficult.
cues.zh: 大型語言模型很難。

cues.en: There is no way to sugarcoat that.
cues.zh: 沒辦法粉飾。

cues.en: The design, the algorithms, the ways to investigate and understand the mechanisms of LMS.
cues.zh: 設計、演算法，以及研究、理解其機制的方法，

cues.en: These come at the intersection of coding and math, machine learning, statistics, linear algebra, and computer science.
cues.zh: 結合程式、數學、機器學習、統計、線性代數與電腦科學。

cues.en: I have done my best to make this course accessible to anyone who really wants to learn, but you also
cues.zh: 我盡力讓真正想學的人都能學，但也，

cues.en: have to appreciate that understanding LMS is not something you can do by just watching a five minute YouTube video while eating dinner and checking your email.
cues.zh: 要理解，不是邊吃晚餐、查信，邊看五分鐘YouTube就能懂LLM。

cues.en: I really, really super duper a lot.
cues.zh: 我非常、非常、極力，

cues.en: Recommend taking notes by hand as you go through the lecture.
cues.zh: 建議上課時手寫筆記。

cues.en: I recommend this in all of my courses, and this is based on many decades of research in education and also comprehension and memory retention.
cues.zh: 所有課都這樣建議，根據數十年的教育、理解和記憶研究。

cues.en: It is simply a fact that you will learn better.
cues.zh: 事實上，這樣學得更好。

cues.en: You will retain that knowledge for longer if you take notes by hand.
cues.zh: 手寫筆記，知識記得更久。

cues.en: Now, maybe you think it's better to type your notes because you can type faster than you can write, but that is actually part of the problem.
cues.zh: 也許覺得打字快，筆記用打的比較好，但這正是問題之一。

cues.en: When you're typing at the speed of the lecture, the information flows from your ears to your fingers.
cues.zh: 打字跟上講課速度時，資訊從耳朵流到手指。

cues.en: But when you have to take notes by hand, it's slower, it's more physically engaging, it's multimodal.
cues.zh: 手寫較慢，身體參與更多，涉及多種感官。

cues.en: And that means that the information needs to be processed and condensed and understood by your brain before your fingers start scratching the pen into the paper.
cues.zh: 資訊必須先經大腦處理、濃縮、理解，手指才把筆寫到紙上。

cues.en: Of course, that said, you can take notes however you like or not take notes at all.
cues.zh: 當然，也可以依喜好記筆記，或完全不記。

cues.en: However you want to engage with this course is fine with me.
cues.zh: 用任何方式參與都可以。

cues.en: I'm just giving you some advice based on a lot of scientific research.
cues.zh: 只是依很多科學研究提供建議。

cues.en: Relatedly, I do not make my lecture slides available.
cues.zh: 相關地，我不提供課程投影片。

cues.en: There are thousands of lines of code that I have made available, and a detailed spreadsheet that gives the main points of each lecture.
cues.zh: 但提供數千行程式，以及詳細試算表，列出各課重點。

cues.en: I will talk more about how to get the code and the detailed lecture overview in a separate video.
cues.zh: 另一段會介紹如何取得程式與詳細課程總覽。

cues.en: Because Llms are such a big topic, and because this course is so long and covers so many topics in depth.
cues.zh: LLM主題龐大，課又長，深入涵蓋很多內容。

cues.en: I recommend having some learning goals before you start really getting into the course.
cues.zh: 建議正式深入前，先訂學習目標。

cues.en: For example, do you just want to gain some familiarity with the architecture and the math underlying LMS without being able to train them from scratch.
cues.zh: 例如只想熟悉架構、底層數學，不需要能從頭訓練。

cues.en: That is completely fine.
cues.zh: 完全沒問題。

cues.en: That's a fantastic learning goal.
cues.zh: 很好的學習目標。

cues.en: And that means that you can actually ignore like two thirds of the course.
cues.zh: 這表示其實可以略過約三分之二，

cues.en: In order to achieve your goals.
cues.zh: 就能達成目標。

cues.en: On the other hand, if your goal is to be a.
cues.zh: 另一方面，如果目標是成為，

cues.en: PhD level mechanistic interpretability researcher working on technical AI safety, then you should probably go through the entire course in more detail.
cues.zh: 從事技術性AI安全、博士程度的機制可解釋性研究者，大概該更詳細學完整課。

cues.en: That said, I really recommend making at least some effort to go through the exercises.
cues.zh: 但仍強烈建議，至少花點力氣做練習。

cues.en: I have tons of exercises and code challenges and projects throughout the entire course.
cues.zh: 全課有大量練習、程式挑戰、專案。

cues.en: And doing the work yourself is hands down the single best way to learn.
cues.zh: 自己做，絕對是最好的學習方式。

cues.en: It's like if you want to learn how to play football, but all you ever do is listen to other people talk about football.
cues.zh: 像想學足球，卻只聽別人談足球。

cues.en: Of course, if you really want to learn football, then you do have to learn about the rules and watch other people play and so on.
cues.zh: 當然，要學也得了解規則、看別人踢。

cues.en: One, but you got to get in there.
cues.zh: 但必須親自上場。

cues.en: You got to get in the field and get your hands dirty.
cues.zh: 進場、動手實作。

cues.en: Anyway, I have a separate video about the different levels of difficulty of the exercises.
cues.zh: 另有一段，談練習難度等級。

cues.en: So more to say about this later.
cues.zh: 之後再說。

cues.en: The last point here is that I encourage you to read and contribute to the Q&A forum.
cues.zh: 最後，鼓勵閱讀、參與問答區。

cues.en: This is a really great supplement to the lectures.
cues.zh: 是課程很好的補充。

cues.en: You can read the discussions and also the code solutions that your fellow learners have contributed.
cues.zh: 可以看討論，以及其他學員分享的程式解法。

cues.en: And of course, if you feel like you can contribute to someone else's question, or if you have some thoughts about a lecture, then feel free to engage with the Q&A.
cues.zh: 能幫忙回答問題、或對課程有想法，都歡迎參與。

cues.en: Again, I have a separate lecture that explains how to use the Udemy player and how to best work with the Q&A.
cues.zh: 另有一段介紹Udemy播放器與問答區用法。

cues.en: But the short version for now is that if you want a helpful reply from me, then make sure that you provide some details, maybe some screenshots and code.
cues.zh: 簡單說，想得到有幫助的回覆，就提供細節，也許截圖、程式。

cues.en: You know, if you just write, I can't get this to work.
cues.zh: 只寫「跑不起來」，

cues.en: Please help.
cues.zh: 「請幫忙」。

cues.en: Then there's literally nothing I can do to help you.
cues.zh: 我真的沒辦法幫。

cues.en: Uh, okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: This slide shows what is absolutely necessary to work through this course and what is helpful.
cues.zh: 這張投影片列出必需，以及有幫助，

cues.en: And I recommend as background knowledge, but not strictly necessary.
cues.zh: 建議具備但非嚴格必要的背景。

cues.en: Well I think this column speaks for itself.
cues.zh: 這欄應該很清楚。

cues.en: So let me just say a few things about what is helpful.
cues.zh: 只稍談有幫助的部分。

cues.en: Now I try to explain the math, the machine learning concepts, the linear algebra principles, etc.
cues.zh: 會在需要時，解釋數學、機器學習概念、線性代數原理，

cues.en: as I go through the course when that knowledge becomes necessary.
cues.zh: 等知識。

cues.en: And if you are brand new to Python and deep learning, then you can have a look through the appendix sections at the end of the course.
cues.zh: 全新接觸Python、深度學習，可以看課尾附錄。

cues.en: And that's where I have some basic tutorials about coding and deep learning and gradient descent.
cues.zh: 有程式、深度學習、梯度下降的基礎教學。

cues.en: All of that said, I have to be honest with you, if you have zero familiarity with all of these topics, then the course is going to be pretty challenging.
cues.zh: 但坦白說，如果這些全都完全不熟，課會很有挑戰。

cues.en: And so I recommend learning at least some basics about these topics before really diving into this course.
cues.zh: 建議先學一些基礎，再深入。

cues.en: As I'm sure you've seen by now, there are a lot of lectures in this course.
cues.zh: 你應該已看到，課有很多講座。

cues.en: I wanted to make this a complete, in-depth, and intensive course where you really learn a lot of detail
cues.zh: 我想做完整、深入、密集的課，讓你學到許多，

cues.en: about LMS, not just some hand-wavy three minute explanation of some of the most important algorithms in modern technology.
cues.zh: LLM細節，不只是三分鐘含糊解釋現代科技最重要的演算法。

cues.en: So do you really need to watch every single lecture in the order in which it appears?
cues.zh: 真的必須依序看完每段嗎？

cues.en: The short answer is no, you do not.
cues.zh: 簡答，不必。

cues.en: You are the master of your own education here, and I respect that.
cues.zh: 你主導自己的學習，我尊重這點。

cues.en: You can pick and choose.
cues.zh: 可以挑選。

cues.en: You can bop around the course as you like, as you see fit.
cues.zh: 依需要自由跳著看。

cues.en: Indeed, I cover many topics in this course, and maybe not all of them are relevant for you.
cues.zh: 涵蓋很多主題，不一定每個都和你相關。

cues.en: For example, the like the entire second half of this course is focused on mechanistic Interpretability
cues.zh: 例如整個後半段，著重機制可解釋性，

cues.en: as it would prepare you for a technical, AI safety or complex systems research program.
cues.zh: 為技術性AI安全、複雜系統研究做準備。

cues.en: If you are not interested in those topics, then you absolutely do not need to watch any of those lectures unless you find them interesting and you're curious.
cues.zh: 沒興趣就完全不必看，除非覺得有趣、好奇。

cues.en: Also, if you're really just interested in how llms are put together, how attention and transformer
cues.zh: 也許只想了解LLM如何組成、注意力、Transformer，

cues.en: blocks work, and so on, then maybe you decide that the sections on training an LLM from scratch are just not that relevant for you.
cues.zh: 區塊如何運作，就可能覺得從頭訓練的章節不相關。

cues.en: Again, that is totally fine.
cues.zh: 同樣，完全可以。

cues.en: I have made this material available to you, and you get to decide what you want to engage with and at what level of depth.
cues.zh: 材料提供了，由你決定學什麼、深入到什麼程度。

cues.en: Also relevant here is that I generally do not believe that giving some high level overview of a complicated
cues.zh: 也相關，我通常不認為，複雜主題只講高階總覽，

cues.en: topic with no math, no practicing is going to do anything but entertain you for at most two minutes.
cues.zh: 沒數學、沒練習，除了娛樂兩分鐘外能有多少效果。

cues.en: So there's a lot of concepts that I explain here in this course, and maybe I'll have one video to.
cues.zh: 課裡很多概念，也許先一段，

cues.en: Introduce the concept, explain it and show visualizations and do a code demo.
cues.zh: 介紹、解釋、視覺化、程式示範。

cues.en: And then there might be 2 or 3 or maybe four videos after that where I give you exercises, guided exercises
cues.zh: 之後再兩、三、四段，引導練習，

cues.en: to work through so that you can really understand the nuances, the complexities, and the impact of that concept.
cues.zh: 真正理解細節、複雜性與影響。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that means that if you feel like you have a good grasp of a concept and you want to skip some of the examples, definitely feel free to do that.
cues.zh: 所以覺得概念掌握得好，想跳過部分例子，請自由決定。

cues.en: Also, something I recommend if you are concerned about missing material.
cues.zh: 如果擔心漏內容，還有個建議。

cues.en: If you skip a video, what you can do is watch the video at a faster speed like two x.
cues.zh: 跳過影片時，可以用兩倍速看。

cues.en: In my humble opinion, watching a video at two X is too fast to really learn and think and follow along.
cues.zh: 我個人認為，兩倍速太快，難以真正學習、思考、跟著做。

cues.en: But this is a great strategy if you are already familiar with the topic, but you want to make sure you're not missing anything important somewhere in the lecture.
cues.zh: 但已熟悉主題，只想確認沒漏重要內容，這策略很好。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: All that said, please keep in mind that I have designed this course to be cumulative.
cues.zh: 話雖如此，記得課程設計是累積的。

cues.en: So if you skip an entire section and you jump to the next section, you skip over 50 videos.
cues.zh: 跳過整章、一下跨過50段，

cues.en: I might be referring to code or concepts that I have introduced in the section that you skipped.
cues.zh: 我可能引用你跳過章節的程式或概念。

cues.en: That's not necessarily a bad thing, and if you feel like you're comfortable with a section and want to skip it, go for it.
cues.zh: 不一定不好，已熟悉、想跳就跳。

cues.en: Just keep in mind that if you skip over a lot of lectures and a lot of topics, you might get confused about some topic or term that I introduced, but you missed.
cues.zh: 只是跳過很多內容，可能遇到已介紹、你卻沒看到的詞或主題，感到混亂。

cues.en: Here's another question do you need to do all of the exercises?
cues.zh: 另一問題，要做全部練習嗎？

cues.en: I have a ton of exercises throughout this course.
cues.zh: 有大量練習。

cues.en: The short and simple answer is you might guess this from the previous slide.
cues.zh: 簡答，大概從上一張就猜得到。

cues.en: Nope.
cues.zh: 不用。

cues.en: You do not need to do all of the exercises.
cues.zh: 不必做全部。

cues.en: In fact, you don't need to do any of the exercises.
cues.zh: 其實任何練習都不是必做。

cues.en: I know I said this in the previous slide, but you are the master of your own education.
cues.zh: 剛說過，你主導自己的學習。

cues.en: The exercises are there as opportunities for you to learn.
cues.zh: 練習是學習機會。

cues.en: They are not strict requirements that you absolutely must do.
cues.zh: 不是絕對必須完成的嚴格要求。

cues.en: It really depends on how much you want to engage and how deeply you want to understand the concept.
cues.zh: 取決於想參與多少、理解多深。

cues.en: If you just watch the videos and follow along, that is already fantastic.
cues.zh: 只看影片、跟著學，已經很好。

cues.en: But if you really want to understand the concept at a much deeper level, then yeah, you got to get your hands dirty and you got to do some exercises.
cues.zh: 但想更深理解，就得動手、做練習。

cues.en: I have a whole separate video where I will describe the code challenge videos, how to solve them, how to work through them, how to set your own level of preferred difficulty.
cues.zh: 另有整段介紹程式挑戰，如何解、如何做，以及自行設定偏好難度。

cues.en: So the exercises are not necessarily so hard unless you want to make them hard for yourself.
cues.zh: 所以除非自己想增加難度，練習不一定那麼難。

cues.en: Well, that's all I have to say in this video.
cues.zh: 這段要說的就這些。

cues.en: I hope you are now super enthusiastic to start learning about.
cues.zh: 希望你現在非常期待開始學習。
